title: Uncle Julio's: Grill Station Mise
briefing: Dinner service in 20 minutes. Your mesquite grill station needs to be set before the first ticket prints. Fire management, protein staging, tool placement. Go.

expertRecipe.name: Mesquite Grill Station Setup
expertRecipe.platingStandard: All 12 positions filled. Raw and cooked tongs separated. Cold rail at 40°F or below. Mesquite fire started and approaching 450°F. Sani bucket fresh.

steps.whyExplanation: You're about to touch raw protein staging areas and tools that contact food. Start clean.

steps.instruction: Mix fresh sani bucket. Place within arm's reach of the grill.
steps.whyExplanation: Sani solution must be mixed fresh every 2 hours. Old solution loses its kill concentration. You'll need it constantly to wipe tongs between proteins.

steps.instruction: Start mesquite fire. Load wood, ignite, let burn down to ember bed. Takes 30-45 minutes to reach 450°F+.
steps.whyExplanation: Mesquite must burn to embers — flames char the outside and leave the inside raw. Starting the fire first gives it time to come to temp while you set the rest of the station.

steps.instruction: Stock cold rail: marinated chicken, skirt steak, shrimp, peppers/onions. All at 40°F or below.
steps.whyExplanation: Proteins go out last because they start warming immediately. Chicken separate from shrimp — cross-contamination between poultry and shellfish affects allergen safety.

steps.instruction: Set tools: RAW tongs on left, COOKED tongs on right. Never swap. Grill brush, thermometer, and knife within reach.
steps.whyExplanation: Using raw-protein tongs to plate cooked fajitas is textbook cross-contamination. Two sets of tongs, clearly separated, is non-negotiable.

steps.instruction: Place cast-iron sizzle platters on side burner to preheat.
steps.whyExplanation: A cold sizzle platter doesn't sizzle. The smoking platter arriving at the table is the Uncle Julio's signature. Pre-heating takes 10+ minutes.

steps.instruction: Check grill surface temp. Confirm ember bed is building toward 450°F. Adjust air flow if needed.
steps.whyExplanation: Final check before first ticket. If the fire isn't right, you have minutes to fix it — not during a 5-ticket rush.

criticalControlPoints.target: Fresh sani solution at correct concentration
criticalControlPoints.consequence: Every tong wipe and surface clean with dead solution is a contamination event.

criticalControlPoints.target: Raw and cooked tongs physically separated
criticalControlPoints.consequence: Cross-contamination from raw chicken tongs to cooked fajita strips. Salmonella on a finished plate.
